newsitem.title: USA: Corrpro to buy Cathodic for $15 mln cash.
newsitem.headline: Corrpro to buy Cathodic for $15 mln cash.

text.p: Corrpro Cos Inc said Thursday that it has signed a definitive agreement to buy Cathodic Protection Services Inc for $15 million, cash. The company said it expects to close the acquisition in 30 to 45 days.
In the twelve months ended March 31, Cathodic had revenues of approximately $30 million.
Corrpro said that Cathodic is currently owned 75 percent by Offshore Logistics Inc and 25 percent by Curran Holdings Inc, a privately-held pipeline service company in Houston.
Corrpro is a provider of corrosion control engineering services, systems and equipment to the infrastructure, environmental and energy markets.
